subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A child brought a broken toy car to the repair table at the community fair.”?
options: Another brought a radio that no longer worked.
Because of this, many villagers bring things they no longer need.
An old sports stadium was no longer used for major games.
One wheel had fallen off, and the motor no longer worked.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Another brought a radio that no longer worked.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Because of this, many villagers bring things they no longer need.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「An old sports stadium was no longer used for major games.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「One wheel had fallen off, and the motor no longer worked.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「One wheel had fallen off, and the motor no longer worked.」，答案為「One wheel had fallen off, and the motor no longer worked.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「One wheel had fallen off, and the motor no longer worked.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
